cards.text: Meet Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi. He's living among the exiles by the River Kebar, in the land of the Chaldeans, in the fifth year of the exile of Judah's King Jehoiachin. And on the fifth day of the fourth month, the heavens open.

cards.question: True or false: When the heavens open by the River Kebar, Ezekiel sees visions of God.

cards.text: The word of the LORD comes to him directly, and right there by the river, the LORD's hand is upon him. Then Ezekiel looks and sees a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with brilliant light all around it.

cards.question: That great cloud from the north has ___ flashing back and forth.

cards.text: In the center of the fire is a gleam like amber, and within it, the form of four living creatures. Friend, a moth flew into my oven light ONE time and I had to go sit down.
They have a human form, but each one has four faces and four wings. Their legs are straight, and the soles of their feet are like a calf's hooves, gleaming like polished bronze.

cards.question: Under their wings, on all four sides, the living creatures have human ___.

cards.text: Their wings are touching one another as they go, four creatures, four faces each, wing to wing. So how do they change direction?

cards.question: True or false: The living creatures turn as they move.
Each living creature has the face of a man. What are its other three faces?

cards.text: Their wings are spread upward, two touching the wings of the creature on either side and two covering its body. Four wings, every one with a job, and here I am with just a mustache juggling the spatula, the timer AND my dignity.

cards.question: The living creatures go straight ahead without turning as they move. So what decides where they go?

cards.text: In the middle of the creatures is something like glowing coals of fire, or torches, with bright fire moving back and forth between them. And I thought MY oven ran hot the day the dial got stuck on broil.

cards.question: How fast are the living creatures darting back and forth?

answers.text: As quick as flashes of lightning
As quick as a running deer
As quick as a falling star

cards.text: Ezekiel keeps looking at the living creatures, each one with its four faces. Then he notices something on the ground beside each one.

cards.question: What does Ezekiel see on the ground beside each living creature?

cards.text: All four wheels look alike, gleaming like beryl, and their workmanship looks like a wheel within a wheel. Friend, I've got just the one gold base and I still tip into the flour twice a week.

cards.question: True or false: The wheels can go in any of the four directions without pivoting.

cards.text: Their rims are high and awesome, and all four rims are full of eyes all around. That is more eyes than a whole street full of doorbell cameras.

cards.question: True or false: When the living creatures rise from the ground, the wheels stay on the ground.
The wheels rise right along with the living creatures. Why?

answers.text: The spirit of the creatures is in the wheels
The wheels are fastened to the creatures' feet
The creatures lift the wheels with their hands

cards.text: The creatures move, the wheels move, and when they stand still, the wheels stand still. Friend, I can't get one room of people to clap on the same beat.

Now Ezekiel looks up, and spread out above the creatures' heads is the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal. I scrub my oven window every single night and the best it ever does is "foggy."

Under the expanse, their wings stretch out toward one another, and when the creatures move, Ezekiel hears those wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.

cards.question: True or false: When the living creatures stand still, they lower their wings.
A voice comes from above the expanse over the creatures' heads. Above that expanse is the likeness of a ___ with the appearance of sapphire.
On the throne high above the expanse, what does Ezekiel see?

answers.text: A figure like that of a man
A figure like that of a lamb
A figure like that of a dove

cards.text: From what seemed to be His waist up, Ezekiel sees a gleam like amber with what looked like fire within it, and from what seemed to be His waist down, what looked like fire, with brilliant light all around Him. Friend, for this one I'm taking my chef's hat off.

cards.question: The brilliant light around the figure on the throne looks like a ___ in a cloud on a rainy day.

cards.text: Then Ezekiel says it plainly: "This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD." Read that line slow, friend, because every word in it is doing heavy lifting.

cards.question: Ezekiel sees the likeness of the glory of the LORD. What does he do?

cards.text: Facedown on the ground, Ezekiel hears a voice speaking. And that's right where we'll stop for now, friend, because this story is far from done.
